summary: SEPA credit blocked: EU services vendor missing tax residency code on vendor record
description:
Issue summary:
A scheduled SEPA settlement to Empirical AI Ltd (vendor ID V-11293) was rejected by our payment provider due to a missing tax-residency classification and corresponding tax ID on the vendor master. The vendor provides consulting services from Ireland and expects EUR payment this week for invoice INV-2026-1073.

Impact:
- Payment of EUR 28,450 is blocked; vendor has escalated via account manager.
- Potential vendor relation risk if payment is delayed beyond their SLA (7 days).
- Treasury cannot auto-route to partner rails because vendor record fails validation.

Environment:
- Finance production (AP) workflows, payments pipeline via Payments Provider: ClearBank EU connector
- Region: eu-west

Steps to reproduce / observed behaviour:
1) AP batch created with invoice INV-2026-1073 scheduled 2026-03-09.
2) Payment file generated and submitted to ClearBank EU at 08:03 UTC.
3) ClearBank returned rejection with description: "beneficiary validation failed: tax residency code missing".
4) Payment moved to QUARANTINE in payments UI; automated retry blocked by vendor-validation rule.

Logs / attachments referenced:
- payments/clearbank/2026-03-09/trace_V-11293.log (attached)
- vendor-record-export-2026-03-09.csv (attached)

Desired outcome:
- Process invoice payout within 48 hours OR provide an approved exception path for one-off wired settlement after KYC confirmation.

Acceptance criteria:
- Vendor record updated with validated tax residency and tax ID OR
- Treasury executes manual non-SEPA wire and marks record with temporary override and follow-up action to onboard tax docs.
comments: 2026-03-09 09:12 - Priya Singh: Raised to payments ops. ClearBank rejection message attached. Tagging Treasury for exception authority.

2026-03-09 10:04 - Ben Taylor (Payments Ops): Confirmed rejection payload: beneficiary.tax_residency == null. AP system prevented retry. Need vendor to supply either Irish PPS/Tax ID or confirmation of non-resident status.

2026-03-09 11:20 - Sarah Lewis (Vendor Success): Reached out to vendor contact (M. O'Neill). Vendor claims tax ID exists but says it was entered by their procurement team under a different company name variation.

2026-03-09 14:45 - Priya Singh: Exported vendor master and flagged name variants. Suggest manual vendor record reconciliation then resubmit payment. If vendor cannot produce ID within 24 hours, Treasury to approve manual wire.
2026-03-10 08:30 - Treasury Desk (internal): Approved hold-notify flow. Will process manual wire if AP confirms KYC email chain by 2026-03-11 12:00 UTC. Awaiting vendor reply.

2026-03-11 09:15 - Amanda Chen: Vendor provided scanned Irish tax certificate (attached). AP to update vendor record and requeue payment. Marking internal follow-up: ensure tax docs uploaded to vendor profile and set reminder to verify vendor name variants in onboarding checklist.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: vendor onboarding missed field 'tax_residency' during manual data entry (recent vendor import had 3% failure rate).
Verified payment provider rejects beneficiary without tax residency for service invoices originating in EU.
Found name variation: 'Empirical AI Ltd' vs 'Empirical AI Limited' causing duplicate vendor entries (V-11293 vs V-9982). Payment attempted against V-11293 which lacked tax fields.
AP export shows tax_id blank for V-11293 while V-9982 has tax_id present. Consolidation required.
Risk: automatic dedup scripts are disabled for active pay runs to avoid accidental merges; manual reconciliation needed.
workaround: Treasury-approved manual bank transfer (wire) executed as one-off if vendor supplies verifiable tax certificate by 2026-03-11 12:00 UTC. AP must update vendor record post-transfer and create consolidation ticket to merge duplicate vendor entries.
resolution: Pending: awaiting AP vendor record update and tranche reconciliation. Manual wire reserved as contingency.
